summary: Completed backend + frontend testing for multi-tenant AI Voice Sales SaaS platform. 13/13 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend flows all working: auth, admin gating, settings, campaign detail, dialer session ownership, /admin redirect, navbar conditional admin link. Telephony gracefully disabled with Twilio blank keys (as intended).

issues: Stat card testids use 'total-clients', 'total-campaigns', 'total-calls', 'calls-today' — the column heading 'THIS MONTH' in user rows but label in stat card says 'Calls Today'. Backend returns 'total_users' but UI labels it 'Total Clients'. Minor naming inconsistency — not blocking.

passed_tests: GET /api/phone/status returns voice_enabled=true, stt=faster_whisper, tts=edge_tts, telephony_configured=false
POST /api/dialer/launch -> 400 'No pending leads to dial' with empty campaign
GET /api/dialer/campaign/{id} -> 404 when no session; 200 with latest when exists
Dialer pause/resume by another user -> 403 (tenant isolation works)
GET /api/admin/users and /api/admin/stats -> 403 for non-admin, 200 after mongosh flip to is_admin=true
PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/toggle-admin flips is_admin correctly; subsequent admin call then returns 403
Multi-tenant isolation: user A cannot read user B's campaign (404/403); /api/calls scoped to user's campaigns
Test-mode /chat: 'not interested' ends call immediately with not_interested_count>=1
Test-mode /chat: multi-turn conversation reaches end and updates state
Frontend /settings shows STT=faster_whisper, TTS=edge_tts, Telephony='Not configured' in red
Frontend Navbar: Settings visible always, Admin link visible ONLY when user.is_admin=true (after re-login)
Dashboard campaign card click navigates to /campaign/:id (not /campaigns/:id/leads)
Frontend /campaign/:id renders campaign-name, campaign-goal, and telephony-not-configured blue banner when telephony disabled
action_items: (Optional) Align AdminPanel stat-card labels with backend field names (total_users vs Total Clients) for clarity, or add data-testid='total-users' on the stat card.
(Optional) AI orchestrator still uses 'sales agent' phrasing in system prompt which is correct and generic; confirmed no 'automotive'/'B2B' hardcoded strings.
critical_code_review_comments: services/telephony_service.py: TELEPHONY_PROVIDER fallback silently defaults to TwilioProvider even for unknown providers — consider raising or logging warning.
routes/phone_calls.py webhook_gather does not verify Twilio signature — for production, add signature validation to prevent webhook spoofing.
routes/dialer.py _dial_next recursion via asyncio.create_task is fine for in-process but will not resume on worker restart; consider persisting a 'next_run_at' and polling.
models/user.py UserCreate has no password strength validation (min_length). Consider Field(min_length=8) to avoid weak passwords.

routes/auth.py login returns is_admin but the frontend AuthContext caches user in localStorage — any is_admin change in DB requires re-login (documented, but a /api/auth/me refresh endpoint would be cleaner).
test_credentials: Dynamically registered: uitest_*@example.com / Pass1234! for non-admin; uiadmin_*@example.com / Pass1234! promoted via mongosh to is_admin=true.
seed_data_creation: None seeded — tests register fresh users per run with TEST_/uitest_/uiadmin_ prefixes. Test data left in DB for next agent's inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run via `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. All 13 pass in ~13s. Twilio is intentionally not configured — all /api/phone/call and /api/dialer/launch (with leads) will background-fail gracefully. To create admin for UI tests: register via UI, then `mongosh test_database --eval 'db.users.updateOne({email:"X"}, {$set:{is_admin:true}})'`, then LOGOUT and log in again to refresh localStorage AuthContext.user.
rca_of_issues: No bugs found. All 18 requested behaviors verified working.
